item.title: Tech Titans Join Trump to Fete China’s Xi at Lavish State Dinner
item.description: Luminaries from Wall Street and Silicon Valley joined President Donald Trump for a state dinner honoring his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping, in a demonstration of US technological and financial might.
item.dc:creator: Hadriana Lowenkron and Kate Sullivan

item.title: What Is The Thucydides Trap and Why Did Xi Raise It With Trump?
item.description: When China’s President Xi Jinping met US leader Donald Trump in Washington on Thursday he called for greater cooperation between the two countries to avoid the “Thucydides Trap”. It’s a phrase that sounds academic, but it goes to the heart of Beijing’s ambitions for their relationship. And it’s not the first time Xi has invoked it: he raised the same idea when Trump visited China in May.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Choong Wilkins

item.title: Thai Court Case Risks Election Rerun, Renewed Political Turmoil
item.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul’s government faces its biggest survival test yet when one of Thailand’s top courts rules Monday on a case that could invalidate the election that brought it to power.
item.dc:creator: Patpicha Tanakasempipat

item.title: Trump, Xi Tout ‘Friendship’ at Lavish Ceremony
item.description: "Balance of Power" focuses on the intersection of politics and global business. On today's show, Former US Ambassador to China Gary Locke says President Trump's reception of Xi Jinping marks a "remarkable change" in protocol and elevates the Chinese leader's standing at home and abroad. He discusses China's goals for artificial intelligence, the outlook for trade and security agreements, and what could emerge from talks on agriculture, rare earths and a crisis hotline between Washington and Beijing. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: The Debrief: CNN, MS NOW, Politico Reporters Regain White House Entry
item.description: Joe Mathieu spoke with Mario Parker at the White House for a special edition of The Debrief. CNN, MS NOW, and Politico reporters returned to the White House after a standoff over press access. Parker says the scene is beginning to look like a typical high-profile summit again, with more reporters on site for Xi’s state visit. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Gary Locke: State Dinner 'Elevates' Xi's Global Stature
item.description: Former US Ambassador to China Gary Locke says President Trump's reception of Xi Jinping marks a "remarkable change" in protocol and elevates the Chinese leader's standing at home and abroad. He discusses China's goals for artificial intelligence, the outlook for trade and security agreements, and what could emerge from talks on agriculture, rare earths and a crisis hotline between Washington and Beijing. He speaks with Joe Mathieu on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily: US-China AI Arms Race (Podcast)
item.description:
Presidents Donald Trump and Xi Jinping addressed their intense competition over artificial intelligence on Thursday during a summit aimed at keeping ties between the world’s largest economies on track. How the leaders are handling AI is one of the key questions looming over the state visit, with the US president arguing for unfettered development to keep his nation’s edge. China, meanwhile, has criticized American export controls on semiconductors and other inputs that it argues constrains its companies. By contrast, China’s top leader indicated some openness to setting boundaries.
On today's episode:
Michael Shepard, Bloomberg News Senior Editor for Technology & Strategic Industries NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte Dina Esfandiary, Middle East Geoeconomics Lead for Bloomberg Economics Eric Muhlheim, Mozilla CFO & Nina Trentmann, Bloomberg News CFO Briefing Editor (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Lula, Bolsonaro in Dead Heat Amid Fresh Banco Master Revelations
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro are deadlocked less than two weeks before Brazil’s election, a new poll showed, following fresh revelations about the challenger’s ties to a jailed banker at the center of a massive fraud scheme.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Rosati

item.title: Trump Advisers Analyzing Impact of Short-Term Diesel Export Ban
item.description: President Donald Trump’s economic advisers are analyzing the ramifications of a potential short-term ban on US diesel exports, underscoring the seriousness of the administration’s consideration of the idea.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer A. Dlouhy and Erik Wasson

item.title: Why Brazil Can't Hide From Its Debt
item.description: As Brazil heads into an election, its debt problems are becoming harder to ignore. Consumers and businesses are struggling with sky-high borrowing costs as the country’s fiscal outlook alarms investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Poland Says It’s Close to Deal with US on Second Military Base
item.description: The US and Poland are working to open a first permanent American military base in the country that could host about 10,000 troops, Poland’s foreign minister said, as Warsaw seeks to bolster its security and Washington looks to reshape its military presence in Europe.
item.dc:creator: María Paula Mijares Torres

item.title: Trump Hosts China’s Xi With Trade, AI, Taiwan in Focus
item.description: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping kicked off a summit aimed at keeping ties between the world’s largest economies on track. Underneath that pageantry, long-standing feuds linger between the superpower rivals on issues including trade and Taiwan, in addition to the new fight emerging on AI. Stephen Engle reports (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Chile President on US-China Trade, Growth Outlook
item.description: Chile President José Antonio Kast discusses the country's trade relations with China and the US and his outlook for economic growth. (This interview is in Spanish with English translation.) (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Gives Xi a Grand Welcome While Expectations Stay Low
item.description: Both the White House and China are signaling limited ambitions for the summit.
item.dc:creator: Nancy Cook

item.title: NATO's Rutte on Russia-Ukraine War, EU Refining Capacity
item.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte sits down with Bloomberg's Annmarie Hordern outside the UN General Assembly to discuss the efforts to end the Russia-Ukraine war and express his concerns about Europe's shrinking refining capacity. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: DOJ Asks Supreme Court to Back Third-Country Deportations
item.description: The Justice Department asked the US Supreme Court to let the Trump administration resume its aggressive policy of deporting people to countries other than their own, seeking emergency action on a pillar of its immigration agenda.
item.dc:creator: Greg Stohr

item.title: US, Iran Said to Be Exploring Phased Deal to Open Hormuz
item.description: US and Iranian negotiators are exploring a phased deal that would see Tehran reopen the Strait of Hormuz and Washington lift its blockade of Iranian ports, according to a person familiar with the discussions.
item.dc:creator: Fiona MacDonald

item.title: Xi Pushes Trump to ‘Oppose’ Taiwan Independence in Rare Call
item.description: Chinese leader Xi Jinping pressed the US to outright “oppose” Taiwan independence, marking his first public call for Donald Trump to change Washington’s decades-old stance on the self-ruled island.
item.dc:creator: Nectar Gan and Jessie Jiang

item.title: US Seeks to Join Musk in Court Fight With EU Over X Fine
item.description: The US is seeking to join a legal challenge filed by SpaceXAI Chief Executive Officer Elon Musk seeking to dismiss a €120 million ($136.5 million) European Union fine for breaches of online rules by his social media platform X.
item.dc:creator: Chris Strohm and Samuel Stolton

item.title: Trump, Xi Thrust Fierce US-China AI Rivalry Into Spotlight
item.description: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping addressed their intense competition over artificial intelligence on Thursday during a summit aimed at keeping ties between the world’s largest economies on track.
item.dc:creator: Jeff Mason, Hadriana Lowenkron and Nectar Gan
